source: statistically derived from TRAIN Health Index distribution (2026-04-01 to 2026-05-13, ACTIVE state only) — NOT sourced from OKUMA/OEM documentation, which was not available

CRITICAL.basis: train P2 (42.0) — matches the 2% contamination rate used to fit the Isolation Forest

note: These 4 tiers reflect statistical rarity within 2 months of largely-normal operation, not validated failure severity. No EMERGENCY tier is defined — there is no failure history in this dataset to justify a 5th tier distinct from CRITICAL. Revisit once real maintenance/failure events are available to calibrate against.
